Krunk

A lightweight, privacy-minded web browser for Windows 10 and 11.

Looking for the latest release…

What you get

  • Ad and tracker blocking built in, with uBlock Origin's lists and scriptlets (YouTube included).
  • No telemetry. Krunk talks to no server of its own except the daily filter-list and update checks.
  • Encrypted password vault protected by your master password.
  • Third-party cookies blocked, tracking parameters stripped, Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control sent.
  • Cookie and site-data manager, and "Inspect" for developers.
  • Games work: pointer lock and full screen (F11).
  • Light on memory: background tabs go to sleep.
  • Chromium engine (through CEF), bundled: no Edge, no WebView2.

Install

Installer: installs for your user only, without administrator rights, to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Krunk. It adds a Start Menu entry and an entry under Settings → Apps for uninstalling. Your data stays when you uninstall, unless you choose otherwise.

Portable: unzip anywhere and run Krunk.exe.

The files are not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time. Check the SHA-256 shown above before running them: Get-FileHash Krunk-Setup-….exe in PowerShell.

Updates and privacy

Krunk checks for a new version a minute after it starts and once a day. It fetches a small file from this site, /updates/win-x64/latest.json, with its version in the request and nothing else: no ID and nothing about your browsing. A new version is installed only when you choose Update now. Before it runs, Krunk checks the release's Ed25519 signature and the installer's SHA-256. You can turn the check off in Settings → About.

This site sets no cookies, loads nothing from other sites and keeps no access log.

Krunk is open source (MIT). It bundles Chromium through the Chromium Embedded Framework and filter lists by EasyList and uBlock Origin; see the notices in the download.
